hypothesis_text: Starting from the additive-plus-16-dimensional user-video interaction model, use within-user hard-negative mining for pointwise long_view BCE: at the start of each epoch, score all training impressions, retain every positive and at most three highest-scoring negative impressions per user, then train BCE on this refreshed subset with the existing optimizer, learning rate, L2, split, checkpoint proxy, and fixed within-user ranking evaluation unchanged. This tests whether concentrating updates on confusing negatives improves GAUC and nDCG@5 while reducing the current high-recall/low-precision classification tradeoff.
